requirements.statement: An Engagement Manager can create and manage a customer engagement

criteria.must: An Engagement Manager can create an engagement with name, customer, start date, and end date
A created engagement appears in the Engagement Manager's engagement list

requirements.statement: An Engagement Manager can close an engagement, ending its allocations

criteria.must: An Engagement Manager can close an engagement
Closing an engagement ends its active allocations, freeing the allocated team members' capacity

requirements.statement: An Engagement Manager can submit a request for a team member on an engagement

criteria.must: An Engagement Manager can submit a request specifying role/skill needed, percentage of time, and a date range
A submitted request starts in pending status

requirements.statement: An Engagement Manager can see the status of every request they've submitted

criteria.must: An Engagement Manager can view a list of their own requests showing pending, approved, or rejected status

requirements.statement: An Engagement Manager can see who is currently allocated to their engagements

criteria.must: An Engagement Manager can view the team members currently allocated to one of their engagements and each one's allocated percentage

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can see a queue of pending allocation requests

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can view a list of all pending allocation requests across engagements

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can see a team member's current and upcoming allocations and total utilization before approving a request for them

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can view a candidate team member's current and upcoming allocations and total utilization percentage from within a pending request

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager is warned, but not blocked, when approving a request would push a team member over 100% allocated

criteria.must: Approving a request that would push a team member's total allocation over 100% shows a warning
The Resource Manager can still confirm the approval after the warning is shown

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can approve a pending request and assign a specific team member, creating a confirmed allocation

criteria.must: Approving a pending request requires choosing a specific team member
Approving a request changes its status to approved and creates a corresponding confirmed allocation

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can reject a pending request with a reason

criteria.must: Rejecting a pending request requires entering a reason
A rejected request's status changes to rejected and shows the reason to the Engagement Manager

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can edit or cancel an existing allocation

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can edit an existing allocation's percentage or date range
A Resource Manager can cancel an existing allocation, removing it from the team member's active allocations

requirements.statement: A Resource Manager can manage the roster of team members

criteria.must: A Resource Manager can add a new team member with name, role/title, and skills
A Resource Manager can edit an existing team member's details
A Resource Manager can deactivate a team member

requirements.statement: A Team Member can view their own current and upcoming allocations and overall utilization

criteria.must: A Team Member can view their own current and upcoming allocations across engagements
A Team Member can see their own overall utilization percentage

requirements.statement: Engagement Managers and Resource Managers receive an email when a request is submitted or decided

criteria.must: Submitting an allocation request triggers an email notification
Approving or rejecting a request triggers a decision email notification
